title: Kutu (Cuthah), entrance to the underworld in Iraq
place_text: Tell Ibrahim, south-east of Baghdad, Iraq

tellings.quote: and it was a place that was supposed to be the entrance to the underworld. It exists today today in Iraq.

plain: An ancient city called Kutu, or Cuthah, was said to be the entrance to the underworld, and the place still exists today in Iraq, at a site called Tell Ibrahim south-east of Baghdad. The author Peter Levenda, who writes about occult history, tells Michels this without naming a source beyond a book of magic called the Necronomicon, which he credits for the story.
